examples.text: Frau Anna, unsere Empfangsdame, flirtet mit Patienten, obwohl sie Mutter von drei Kindern ist.
examples.english: Ms. Anna, our receptionist, flirts with patients, although she is the mother of three children.

raw.etymology_text: Univerbation of ob + wohl, from the older use of ob as a conditional and concessive conjunction, reinforced with an adverb. Compare obgleich, obschon, obzwar and also gleichwohl.
